rows.note: Use 勉強 as the concise all-purpose choice when someone does something despite not wanting to.

example.english: I reluctantly agreed to help him move.
example.traditional: 我勉強應承咗幫佢搬屋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 min5 koeng5 jing1 sing4 zo2 bong1 keoi5 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use 唔情願噉 when you want to make the person's unwilling attitude explicit.

example.english: They reluctantly handed the keys back to the landlord.
example.traditional: 佢哋唔情願噉交返條鎖匙畀業主。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 m4 cing4 jyun6 gam2 gaau1 faan2 tiu4 so2 si4 bei2 jip6 zyu2
